title: Quote Waits for Real Data
description: Letting someone confirm a booking before the price has even loaded would be a good way to ship something for free by accident. The Pricing step's Next button should stay off until a real quote is in hand.
successCondition: On arrival at the Pricing step, the "Next: Confirm" button is disabled during the brief window before POST /api/booking/quote resolves, and becomes enabled only once the quote breakdown (distance, fees, total) is actually rendered on screen — never enabled while the breakdown section is still absent.
hints: The quote fetch is fast in local dev, so you may need to check the very first render tick rather than assuming there's a long loading window to catch.
Practice mode's "Slow network" toggle can widen this window deliberately if you want a more reliable repro.
